update: Reanalysis is a conditional offer. Ask for existing code before building; no claim the corpus lacks it.

statement: A bounded, openly documented plant-data reanalysis is a plausible collaboration proposal, conditional on file access and checking existing code.
scope: Three selected studies and publicly described services; no exhaustive systematic review or independent replication performed.
limitations: Dataset files not retrieved; independent replication not verified; full corpus not audited.
